Trip.title: Trip
Trip.description: A user-saved multi-Reel travel trip containing Reel input sources, extracted and geocoded places, and day-by-day itinerary configuration.

title.description: Trip title derived from destinations or user-edited.

daysCount.description: Number of days in the itinerary (1 to 10).

startTimeMinutes.description: Daily start time in minutes from midnight (0 to 1439).

reelSources.description: Up to 10 Instagram Reel links, captions, or media sources included in this trip.

places.description: Extracted and geocoded places assigned to itinerary days.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() on creation.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() on creation and update.

Feedback.title: Feedback
Feedback.description: User accuracy feedback submitted after reviewing a generated Reel itinerary.

rating.description: Whether the itinerary matched what the Reel showed.

comment.description: Optional user comment on extraction or routing accuracy.

reelCount.description: Number of Reels in the trip when feedback was given.

placeCount.description: Number of places in the trip when feedback was given.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() on creation.

/users/{userId}/trips/{tripId}.description: User-owned saved trips and day-by-day itineraries.

/users/{userId}/feedback/{feedbackId}.description: User-submitted accuracy feedback logs for real user evidence.
